dimensions.obligation_correctness: Recover coalescing, departure persistence, view retirement, exact consumption and preview scope.
dimensions.evidence_grounding: Cite candidate-visible source and behavior documentation.
dimensions.failure_prediction: Predict lost drafts, wrong-document writes, duplicate timers, retired badges and preview publication.
dimensions.unsupported_claim_penalty: Do not invent navigation callbacks, remote acknowledgements or change preview timing without authorization.

obligations.statement: After a 120 ms quiet interval, each editor burst writes its latest text once and later bursts remain live.
obligations.event_relation: latest edit precedes quiet expiry, which precedes one write
obligations.failure_if_violated: Per-keystroke traffic remains or a later burst is dropped.

obligations.statement: Close/open preserves the departed document's latest accepted text under its own key before returning.
obligations.event_relation: departing pending commit precedes navigation return
obligations.failure_if_violated: Close loses text or a switch writes A's text into B.

obligations.statement: The departing save badge stops before its handoff write, while an active view still receives its own saves.
obligations.failure_if_violated: A retired view renders status or active status is globally suppressed.

obligations.statement: A batch flushed during departure cannot commit again from its old timer.
obligations.event_relation: flush cancels timer and retires pending state before write
obligations.failure_if_violated: A departed draft is written twice.

obligations.statement: Hiding transient preview work discards it and reuse can schedule fresh work.
obligations.event_relation: hide precedes discard and prohibits later publication of the hidden query
obligations.failure_if_violated: A shared-helper change publishes hidden preview work.

obligations.statement: Preview remains at 40 ms unless the authorization suffix grants 120 ms.
obligations.event_relation: last query precedes publication by the authorized interval
obligations.failure_if_violated: Editor-only maintenance silently changes adjacent timing.
